(gentle solo piano, sparse and warm)

[Verse 1]
Warmth in a closed heart.
I walk the length of The Grain of It and stop.

[Pre-Chorus]
What I can point to is warmth in a closed heart.
Soft keys underline The Grain of It and then rest.

[Chorus]
The Grain of It begins when the first line does.
I notice warmth in a closed heart before the room does.
I say The Grain of It once, then let the notes finish.

[Verse 2]
I leave The Grain of It where the light already was.
Warmth in a closed heart.

[Piano Solo]
(expressive melodic piano solo, sustained and tender)

[Bridge]
Nothing in The Grain of It argues with the quiet.
